name: Theresa Bond
title: Board President, Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District
years_of_service: Appointed in lieu of election to the Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District Board of Trustees in 2024; current term expires 2028, per the district's board directory. She previously served on the Lakeside Joint School Board from 2010 to 2020.
background: Bond brings over a decade of prior school board experience from her service on the Lakeside Joint School Board (2010-2020) before joining the Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District Board of Trustees. Her professional background includes roles at technology companies Apple Computer and Sun Microsystems, followed by a position with Avid Technology. The district's board directory lists her current occupation as a COVID-19 Community Isolation and Contact Tracing (CICT) worker for the Santa Clara County Public Health Department.

Her community involvement includes PTA presidency, facilitation work with Project Cornerstone, and coordination of YMCA Camp Celiac. She has hosted foreign exchange students through AFS liaison work. She is a longtime Santa Cruz Mountains resident with two sons, both Los Gatos High School alumni.

As Board President, she presided over the board's vote to place Measure N, a $321,000,000 facilities bond covering Los Gatos High School and Saratoga High School, on the November 3, 2026 ballot; full detail on that measure is covered in content/measures/scc-measure-n-2026.json and not duplicated here.
attendance: No individually published meeting-attendance or voting-participation record for Board President Bond was found. Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District does not appear to publish a per-trustee attendance scorecard on its public board pages; board agendas and minutes are posted but were not tallied individually within this session's tool budget.
